mapper.sql: select m.id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.content, m.related_order_id, m.related_demand_id, m.message_type, m.file_url, m.file_name, m.is_read, m.created_at, su1.username as sender_name, su2.username as receiver_name, su1.role as sender_role, su2.role as receiver_role, concat('订单#', o.id, ' - ', fp.name) as order_info, concat('需求#', br.id, ' - ', br.product_name) as demand_info from messages m left join sys_user su1 on m.sender_id = su1.id left join sys_user su2 on m.receiver_id = su2.id left join orders o on m.related_order_id = o.id left join farmer_product fp on o.product_id = fp.id left join buyer_requirement br on m.related_demand_id = br.id
mapper.select:
where ((m.sender_id = #{userId1} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (m.sender_id = #{userId2} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId1}))
AND m.related_order_id = #{relatedOrderId}
AND m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
order by m.created_at asc

select m.id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.content, m.related_order_id, m.related_demand_id, m.message_type, m.file_url, m.file_name, m.is_read, m.created_at, su1.username as sender_name, su2.username as receiver_name, su1.role as sender_role, su2.role as receiver_role, concat('订单#', o.id, ' - ', fp.name) as order_info, concat('需求#', br.id, ' - ', br.product_name) as demand_info, COALESCE(unread.unread_count, 0) as unread_count from ( select case when sender_id = #{userId} then receiver_id else sender_id end as other_user_id, COALESCE(related_order_id, 0) as order_id, max(created_at) as max_time from messages where sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} group by case when sender_id = #{userId} then receiver_id else sender_id end, COALESCE(related_order_id, 0) ) latest inner join messages m on ( (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.receiver_id = latest.other_user_id) OR (m.sender_id = latest.other_user_id AND m.receiver_id = #{userId}) ) AND COALESCE(m.related_order_id, 0) = latest.order_id AND m.created_at = latest.max_time left join sys_user su1 on m.sender_id = su1.id left join sys_user su2 on m.receiver_id = su2.id left join orders o on m.related_order_id = o.id left join farmer_product fp on o.product_id = fp.id left join buyer_requirement br on m.related_demand_id = br.id left join ( select case when sender_id = #{userId} then receiver_id else sender_id end as other_user_id, COALESCE(related_order_id, 0) as order_id, count(*) as unread_count from messages where receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 group by case when sender_id = #{userId} then receiver_id else sender_id end, COALESCE(related_order_id, 0) ) unread on ( latest.other_user_id = unread.other_user_id AND latest.order_id = unread.order_id ) order by m.created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into messages( sender_id, receiver_id, content, related_order_id, related_demand_id, message_type, file_url, file_name, is_read, created_at )values( #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{relatedOrderId}, #{relatedDemandId}, #{messageType}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, 0, now() )
mapper.delete:
delete from messages where id in
#{id}
